values.binNote: No calculation row directly outputs the per-missile reduced value; it is BaseDamage/BonusADRatio/APRatio scaled by ExtraHitReduction=0.25, as also embedded in MaxDamageTotal's formula.

MaxDamage rows equal the base [90,123.75,...,225], confirming base*(1+0.25*5). The scaling coefficients 1.2375 (bonusAd) and 0.45 (ap) are not printed directly as separate data rows: they equal BonusADRatio=0.55 and APRatio=0.2 each multiplied by the same (1+ExtraHitReduction*5)=2.25 factor embedded in MaxDamageTotal's formula (BaseDamage+ratio*stat, then plus that whole sum times 5 times ExtraHitReduction=0.25), which algebraically produces coef*(1+5*0.25)=coef*2.25.

MaxDamageEvolved rows equal the base [150,206.25,...,375], confirming base*(1+0.25*11). The scaling coefficients 2.0625 (bonusAd) and 0.75 (ap) are not printed directly as separate data rows: they equal BonusADRatio=0.55 and APRatio=0.2 each multiplied by the (1+ExtraHitReduction*11)=3.75 factor embedded in {b2bd0d2f}'s formula (BaseDamage+ratio*stat, then plus that whole sum times 11 times ExtraHitReduction=0.25), which algebraically produces coef*(1+11*0.25)=coef*3.75.

mechanics.claim: The swarm fires 6 missiles that split among nearby visible enemies, each hitting 0.4 seconds after cast, dealing separate damage instances.
mechanics.quote: releases a swarm of 6 missiles that evenly distributes among nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each one hitting their target after {{fd|0.4}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: Against a single target, all 6 (or 12 evolved) missiles hit it, but only the first deals full damage; the rest deal reduced damage.
mechanics.quote: Non-minions take {{ap|{{#var:mod}}*100}}% damage from missiles beyond their first.

mechanics.claim: The first missile on a target is a single area-damage instance, while subsequent missiles on the same target are separate persistent area-damage instances.
mechanics.quote: The first missile on a target applies {{tip|area damage}}, while the rest on the same target apply {{tip|persistent area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield only blocks one of the missiles, not all of them.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} only block the damage from a single missile.

mechanics.claim: Targets are locked in at the moment of cast and do not change if the caster or target moves afterward.
mechanics.quote: ''Icathian Rain'' acquires its targets upon cast. Moving will not change its targets.

mechanics.claim: Casting Supercharge does not interrupt or stop the already-fired missiles.
mechanics.quote: Charging {{ai|Supercharge|Kai'Sa}} will not stop the missiles from firing.

mechanics.claim: When all missiles converge on a single target, it takes 1 second total for them all to land.
mechanics.quote: It takes 1 second for all missiles to fire at a single target.

mechanics.claim: Minions below 35% health take double damage from the missiles (does not apply to champions).
The ability requires a nearby enemy to be cast at all.
mechanics.quote: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability.''
